hypotheses.justification: Finiteness is only needed by the auxiliary coverage lemmas through range_ι_comp_eq_univ. In that proof, replace the argument that W is closed by observing that π.base '' W = π.base '' U, which is closed because π.isClosedMap and hUcl. W remains open for an arbitrary group, so its complement has closed image as before. The remaining argument and downstream coverage lemmas work unchanged without finiteness. No enumeration or finite union is then needed, including for infinite G.

This follows from hsec and IsFinite π. The range of π.base is closed since π.isClosedMap. If its open complement V were nonempty, π ⁻¹ᵁ V would be empty, so its section ring would be subsingleton (the instance for Γ(C, ⊥) in Scheme.lean). Injectivity hsec V would force Γ(X, V) to be subsingleton, contradicting Scheme.component_nontrivial for nonempty V. Thus π.base is surjective, and the original proof applies. This argument handles empty schemes as well and does not require Finite G; both reported hypotheses can be deleted together.
